evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rose steadily from ~6-8 ppm during ramp to 12, 16, 20.7, 27.2 ppm during growth
Tube pressure rose from ~2.96 to 3.044, 3.07, 3.122, 3.209 Torr with Ar setpoint unchanged
MFC reads ~100 sccm, matching setpoint, so the pressure rise is not from extra Ar flow
Thermocouple holding at the 750 C setpoint and heater power is consistent, so temperature control looks normal

args.missing_evidence: A leak-up (rate-of-rise) test with the tube isolated, or a leak check at the flanges, would confirm air ingress. A rising O2 reading together with rising pressure argues against an exhaust blockage, since a blockage would raise pressure without adding oxygen.
